title: OpenNWM: A Generalist Navigation World Model with Latent Action Pretraining
summary: Navigation world models predict future observations conditioned on navigation actions to support planning, but their generalization across real-world environments remains constrained by the limited coverage of action-labeled data. Action-free navigation videos provide diverse visual experience, yet lack the recorded actions required for action-conditioned training. We introduce OpenNWM, a generalist navigation world model with latent action pretraining. It learns universal latent actions from large-scale action-free videos through visual prediction pretraining, and further aligns them with physical motions via action-conditioned post-training. To support video pretraining, we curate NavAnywhere, a large-scale action-free navigation video dataset comprising 17.5 million visual observations from 15 heterogeneous sources. It captures navigation by ground robots, humans, and drones, with diverse viewpoints and motion patterns across five broad scene types: residential areas, public and commercial spaces, urban settings, parks, and natural landscapes. Experiments demonstrate improved visual prediction on in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks, together with improved navigation performance. These results show that latent-action pretraining enables diverse, action-free videos to improve dynamics learning and generalization for open-world navigation.
summary_zh: 导航世界模型依据导航动作预测未来观测以支持规划，但其在真实环境中的泛化能力仍受限于动作标注数据覆盖不足的问题。无动作导航视频提供了丰富的视觉经验，却缺少动作条件训练所需的记录动作。我们提出了OpenNWM，一种具有潜在动作预训练的通用导航世界模型。该模型通过视觉预测预训练，从大规模无动作视频中学习通用潜在动作，并通过动作条件后训练将其与物理运动对齐。为支持视频预训练，我们构建了NavAnywhere数据集，这是一个包含来自15个异构来源的1750万视觉观测的大规模无动作导航视频数据集。该数据集涵盖了地面机器人、人类和无人机的导航行为，具有多样化的视角和运动模式，涉及五类广泛场景：居民区、公共与商业空间、城市环境、公园以及自然景观。实验结果表明，该模型在域内和域外基准测试中均提升了视觉预测性能，同时改善了导航表现。这些结果证明，潜在动作预训练能够利用多样的无动作视频增强开放世界导航中的动态学习与泛化能力。
tldr: OpenNWM introduces latent action pretraining on large-scale action-free navigation videos to build a generalist navigation world model, improving visual prediction and downstream navigation performance across diverse environments.
tldr_zh: OpenNWM 通过在大规模无动作导航视频上进行潜在动作预训练，构建通用导航世界模型，提升了跨多种环境的视觉预测和导航性能。

title: ODE Policy: Robot Learning via Action Dynamics, Not Actions
summary: Most robot policies, whether trained by imitation learning (IL) or reinforcement learning (RL), map observations to action values at discrete control steps and leave the continuity of physical motion to be learned implicitly. We propose ODE policy, which learns the dynamics of the action rather than the action itself. A neural ordinary differential equation (ODE) learns the vector field of the action by matching the integrated actions to the targets over short action chunks in IL and single control steps in RL. A lightweight diversity head captures multi-modal behavior by randomizing the direction of the field. At deployment, each action is integrated from the previous one, so the executed trajectory is continuous by construction. We evaluate it as a visuomotor policy, as the action head of vision-language-action (VLA) and world action models (WAMs), and as the actor of model-based RL against 14 baselines on unimanual, bimanual, dexterous, locomotion, and loco-manipulation tasks. In IL, against flow matching, it reaches 5.9$\times$ the success, 5.4$\times$ the generalization, and 3.9$\times$ the mode balance after one epoch, and generates actions 10.8$\times$ faster. It mostly moves more smoothly than human demonstrations. On 14 real-world tasks across single-arm, dual-arm, dexterous, and humanoid robots, it achieves the highest success rate. In RL, it further speeds up SuperMimic for humanoid motion tracking and smooths its actions. Efficient in learning, data, parameters, and execution, ODE policy offers a promising path to scaling robot learning.
summary_zh: 大多数机器人策略，无论是通过模仿学习（IL）还是强化学习（RL）训练的，都在离散控制步骤上将观测映射到动作值，而将物理运动的连续性留给隐式学习。我们提出ODE策略，它学习动作的动力学而非动作本身。神经常微分方程（ODE）通过在IL中的短动作块和RL中的单控制步骤上将积分动作与目标匹配来学习动作的向量场。一个轻量级多样性头通过随机化场的方向来捕捉多模态行为。在部署时，每个动作从前一个动作积分而来，因此执行的轨迹在构造上就是连续的。我们将其作为视觉运动策略、视觉-语言-动作（VLA）和世界动作模型（WAM）的动作头，以及基于模型的RL的 actor，在单臂、双臂、灵巧、运动和移动操作任务上与14个基线进行评测。在IL中，相较于流匹配，它在一次epoch后达到5.9倍的成功率、5.4倍的泛化能力和3.9倍的模式平衡，且生成动作速度快10.8倍。它的运动大多比人类演示更平滑。在涵盖单臂、双臂、灵巧和类人机器人的14个真实世界任务上，它取得了最高成功率。在RL中，它进一步加速了SuperMimic用于类人运动跟踪并使其动作更平滑。在学习、数据、参数和执行方面均高效，ODE策略为规模化机器人学习提供了一条有前景的路径。
tldr: ODE Policy replaces direct action prediction with learning action dynamics via a neural ODE, producing continuous trajectories by construction. It is evaluated as a visuomotor policy, VLA/WAM action head, and RL actor across 14 real-world tasks, achieving state-of-the-art success with higher efficiency.
tldr_zh: ODE Policy 用神经ODE学习动作的动力学而非直接预测动作，从而保证执行轨迹的连续性。其在14项真实世界任务中作为视觉运动策略、VLA/WAM动作头及RL actor，实现了最高成功率且更高效。

title: HuG: Learning Humanoid Whole-Body Affordance-Aware Grasping with Active Perception
summary: Acquiring objects in human environments is hard for humanoids: targets are partially occluded under egocentric viewpoints, and reaching them demands coordinated whole-body motion that keeps the target visible and reachable while the base stays stable. We present HuG, a framework for whole-body affordance-aware grasping with active perception that couples perception and action through a Perceive-Align-Grasp pipeline: belief-driven active perception resolves occlusion by treating viewpoint as an explicit decision variable; a point-cloud-conditioned affordance policy proposes whole-body grasps; and an affordance-aware alignment stage repositions the body to the most executable configuration. A key insight is that, on a floating base, kinematic validity is not enough: we curate training data with controller-in-the-loop dynamics simulation, rejecting 73% of kinematically valid grasps that would destabilize the deployment controller, so the policy learns kinodynamically feasible affordances. Trained entirely in simulation with zero real demonstrations, HuG attains 87.5% real-world success on a multi-level shelf task, generalizes to novel objects, and holds at least 73% success at every tested height. Beyond generalizing within its training distribution, the policy extrapolates spatially: at scale in simulation it succeeds at table heights well below any seen during training, indicating that kinodynamically filtered synthetic data grounds affordances in object geometry and whole-body feasibility rather than in memorized configurations.
summary_zh: 在人形机器人上获取人类环境中的物体十分困难：在以自我为中心的视角下，目标往往被部分遮挡，而够到目标需要协调的全身运动，在保持目标可见且可达的同时维持基座稳定。我们提出了HuG，一个面向全身可供性感知抓取的框架，通过主动感知将感知与动作耦合，采用“感知-对齐-抓取”流水线：信念驱动的主动感知将视角视为显式决策变量以解决遮挡问题；以点云为条件的可供性策略提出全身抓取方案；可供性感知的对齐阶段将身体重新定位到最可执行的构型。一个关键洞见是，在浮动基座上，仅满足运动学有效性是不够的：我们通过控制器在环的动力学仿真来策展训练数据，剔除了73%虽满足运动学有效但会导致部署控制器失稳的抓取，从而使策略学习到运动动力学可行的可供性。HuG完全在仿真中训练，零真实演示，在多层级货架任务上达到87.5%的真实世界成功率，可泛化到新物体，并在每个测试高度上保持至少73%的成功率。除了在训练分布内泛化外，该策略还能在空间上外推：在仿真中大规模测试时，它能在远低于训练中见过的任何高度的桌面高度上成功，这表明经过运动动力学过滤的合成数据将可供性建立在物体几何和全身可行性之上，而非记忆的构型之中。
tldr: HuG is a whole-body affordance-aware grasping framework for humanoids that couples belief-driven active perception with a point-cloud-conditioned affordance policy and controller-in-the-loop kinodynamic filtering, achieving 87.5% real-world success on multi-level shelf tasks trained purely in simulation.
tldr_zh: HuG 是一个面向人形机器人的全身可供性感知抓取框架，通过信念驱动的主动感知、基于点云的可供性策略以及控制器在环的运动动力学过滤，实现仅用仿真训练即可在多层货架任务上达到 87.5% 的真实世界成功率。

title: Vision-Language Models Are Joint Denoisers in Robotic Action Generation
summary: Diffusion-based vision-language-action (VLA) models cascade pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) with diffusion action experts, but typically restrict the VLM to providing static conditioning. This separation limits how much pretrained perception and reasoning can guide action generation, especially in out-of-distribution settings. We introduce JADE, a Joint Action DEnoiser that enables the VLM and action expert to jointly refine actions. Our key insight is that structured action latents allow the VLM to read the current noisy action together with visual observations and language instructions. At every denoising step, the VLM contextualizes the noisy action and guides the action expert through gated cross-attention, so that its guidance evolves with the action being generated. We further supervise the VLM to recover clean action latents from noisy ones, which gives it a direct action-learning signal and couples perception with control. Additionally, joint denoising enables JADE to generate actions with fewer sampling steps, helping offset the additional cost of VLM participation. An adaptive step-size schedule further balances task performance and inference latency. On RoboDojo, JADE achieves an average success rate of 12.67%, the highest among the evaluated $π_{0.5}$-based methods, and is competitive with recent VLA and WAM foundation models pretrained at scale. It also improves performance on RoboTwin 2.0 and raises the average success rate across four real-world bimanual tasks by 20.8 percentage points compared with $π_{0.5}$.
summary_zh: 基于扩散的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）与扩散动作专家模型级联，但通常限制VLM仅提供静态条件信息。这种分离限制了预训练的感知与推理能力对动作生成的指导作用，尤其在分布外场景中表现更为明显。我们提出了JADE（联合动作去噪器），使VLM与动作专家能够共同精化动作。我们的关键洞察在于，结构化的动作潜变量使VLM能够在读取当前含噪动作的同时，结合视觉观测和语言指令进行处理。在每个去噪步骤中，VLM对含噪动作进行上下文理解，并通过门控交叉注意力引导动作专家，从而使VLM的指导信息随生成动作的演化而动态调整。我们还进一步监督VLM从含噪潜变量中恢复干净的动作潜变量，这为其提供了直接的动作学习信号，并将感知与控制耦合起来。此外，联合去噪使JADE能够以更少的采样步数生成动作，从而部分抵消VLM参与带来的额外计算开销。自适应的步长调度机制进一步在任务性能与推理延迟之间取得平衡。在RoboDojo基准上，JADE实现了12.67%的平均成功率，在所评估的基于π₀.₅的方法中最高，并且与近期大规模预训练的VLA和WAM基础模型具有竞争力。JADE还在RoboTwin 2.0上提升了性能，并在四个真实世界双臂任务上将平均成功率相比π₀.₅提高了20.8个百分点。
tldr: JADE enables a pretrained VLM and a diffusion action expert to jointly denoise action latents, with the VLM reading noisy actions and providing evolving guidance via gated cross-attention, improving VLA policy performance on RoboDojo, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world bimanual tasks.
tldr_zh: JADE 让预训练视觉语言模型与扩散动作专家联合去噪动作潜变量，VLM 在每一步读取含噪动作并通过门控交叉注意力提供随生成过程演化的引导，在 RoboDojo、RoboTwin 2.0 和真实双臂任务上提升了 VLA 策略性能。

title: Xiaomi Auto World Model 2.0: Causal World Models for Real-World Driving and Embodied Intelligence
summary: We present Xiaomi Auto World Model 2.0, a unified streaming causal world model for Physical AI. It models and generates causal physical evolution in the real world, and unifies heterogeneous conditioning inputs for view-consistent generation. The architecture integrates View-Temporal Attention (VTA) to capture cross-view spatial dependencies and temporal dynamics, together with Multi-view Rotary Position Encoding (RoPE) to encode positional relationships across views and time. WorldRec 2.0 reconstructs static and dynamic 3D Gaussians from multi-view, multi-temporal observations in a single forward pass and uses their renderings as explicit scene context to preserve geometry and appearance during long-horizon generation. Conditioning inputs are fused through VAE latent concatenation in a shared representation space. We incorporate Gated Linear Attention (GLA) into the temporal layers of VTA for efficient streaming inference, reducing computation and KV-cache memory during multi-view rollouts. A physical-interaction data pipeline covers diverse interactions and long-tailed events. From Pre-train onward, these data are combined with large-scale videos and heterogeneous visual modalities to learn visual, geometric, and dynamic priors. During Mid-train, training across diverse view configurations further improves the model's ability to capture how actions and object states shape subsequent scene evolution. After distillation-based Post-train, we apply the model to closed-loop simulation, closed-loop training, and World Action Model (WAM) applications. These applications generate physically consistent future states and support world-state prediction, policy learning, and action generation for Physical AI.
summary_zh: 我们提出了小米汽车世界模型2.0，一个用于物理AI的统一流式因果世界模型。该模型建模并生成真实世界中的因果物理演化，并统一异构条件输入以实现视图一致的生成。其架构集成了视图-时间注意力机制以捕捉跨视图空间依赖和时间动态，同时结合多视图旋转位置编码以编码跨视图和时间的位姿关系。WorldRec 2.0通过单次前向传播从多视图、多时间观测中重建静态和动态3D高斯体，并将其渲染结果作为显式场景上下文，以在长时程生成过程中保持几何与外观的一致性。条件输入通过VAE潜变量拼接在共享表示空间中进行融合。我们在VTA的时间层中引入门控线性注意力以实现高效的流式推理，从而在多视角推演过程中降低计算量和KV缓存内存占用。物理交互数据流水线覆盖了多样化的交互场景和长尾事件。从预训练阶段开始，这些数据与大规模视频及异质视觉模态相结合，以学习视觉、几何和动态先验。在中期训练阶段，跨多种视图配置的训练进一步提升了模型捕捉动作和物体状态如何塑造后续场景演化的能力。在基于蒸馏的后训练阶段之后，我们将该模型应用于闭环仿真、闭环训练以及世界动作模型应用。这些应用生成物理一致性的未来状态，并支持物理AI的世界状态预测、策略学习与动作生成。
tldr: This paper introduces Xiaomi Auto World Model 2.0, a unified streaming causal world model for physical AI that generates view-consistent future states, supports closed-loop simulation, and enables World Action Model applications for driving and embodied intelligence.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了小米自动驾驶世界模型2.0，一种统一的流式因果世界模型，用于物理AI，可生成视图一致的未来状态，支持闭环仿真，并推动世界动作模型在驾驶和具身智能中的应用。

title: Scene-Adaptive Readout and Decoding in Diffusion Driving VLAs
summary: Diffusion driving vision-language-action models repeatedly execute the backbone at every denoising stage, incurring substantial inference cost, while it remains unclear whether all scenes require the same decoding computation. To distinguish when a trajectory becomes readable from how much further refinement it requires, we analyze trajectory readout across network depth and decoding progress. We identify a depth-decoding dissociation in which late-layer representations already support useful trajectory readout after the first forward sweep, whereas early-layer representations benefit more from continued decoding. We further find that both the preferred readout layer and decoding depth vary across scenes. Based on these observations, we propose a scene-adaptive readout and decoding framework. A scene-conditioned readout MoE adaptively weights and combines trajectory predictions from layer-specific late-layer representations after a single backbone sweep, while an adaptive decoding policy applies additional native refinement only when required by the scene. We evaluate our framework on two diffusion driving VLAs across the Waymo E2E and nuScenes benchmarks. Our method improves validation RFS by up to 0.56 while also improving test performance, and achieves an end-to-end speedup of up to $6.0\times$ on Waymo E2E, while consistently reducing trajectory error on nuScenes. These results demonstrate that scene-level readout and decoding allocation improves planning quality while avoiding unnecessary decoding. Our code is available at https://github.com/sjyu001/SARD
summary_zh: 扩散驱动的视觉-语言-动作模型在每个去噪阶段都会重复执行主干网络，导致推理成本显著增加，然而目前尚不清楚是否所有场景都需要同等程度的解码计算。为区分轨迹何时变得可读与还需要多少进一步精化，我们跨网络深度和解码进度分析了轨迹读出过程。我们发现了一种深度-解码分离现象：在首次前向扫描后，深层表示已能够支持有效的轨迹读出，而浅层表示则更受益于持续解码。此外，我们还发现首选读出层和解码深度均随场景变化而变化。基于这些观察，我们提出了一种场景自适应的读出与解码框架。场景条件化的读出专家混合模型（readout MoE）在单次主干网络扫描后，对来自特定层深层表示的轨迹预测进行自适应加权与组合，而自适应解码策略仅在场景需要时才应用额外的原生精化。我们在Waymo E2E和nuScenes基准上对两种扩散驱动视觉-语言-动作模型评估了该框架。我们的方法在验证集上RFS最高提升0.56，同时测试性能也有所改善，在Waymo E2E上实现了高达$6.0\times$的端到端加速，并在nuScenes上持续降低了轨迹误差。这些结果表明，场景级读出与解码分配能够提升规划质量，同时避免不必要的解码。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/sjyu001/SARD 获取。
tldr: The paper identifies a depth-decoding dissociation in diffusion driving VLAs and proposes a scene-adaptive readout MoE and adaptive decoding policy to improve planning quality while achieving up to 6x end-to-end speedup.
tldr_zh: 该论文识别了扩散驾驶VLA中的深度-解码分离现象，并提出了场景自适应的读出MoE和自适应解码策略，在提升规划质量的同时实现最高6倍的端到端加速。

title: Back to the Future: Predicting Long-Horizon Dynamics with Retrospective Correction for Disturbance-Aware Retrieval
summary: Retrieving objects from densely packed storage requires anticipating how contact disturbs surrounding objects when limited clearance prevents lifting the target over clutter. However, contact can propagate beyond the target's immediate neighbors, while accumulated prediction errors make learned dynamics unreliable over long planning horizons. We introduce DARE (Disturbance-Aware REtrieval), a geometry-aware relational dynamics framework that uses retrospective correction to improve long-horizon prediction for disturbance-aware retrieval. DARE encodes compact object descriptors and predicts action-conditioned disturbance propagation through object-level message passing. When a sparse observation becomes available, a learned corrector uses the prediction discrepancy to amend an earlier predicted state and reruns the intervening dynamics, propagating the correction through the predicted contact chain. These predictions guide a receding-horizon planner that balances retrieval progress against displacement and rotation of surrounding objects, permitting necessary contact while discouraging harmful disturbance. Experiments in planar and RoboCasa environments evaluate long-horizon prediction, generalization, and robustness for disturbance-aware retrieval in dense clutter. See our project website: https://the-back-to-the-future.github.io
summary_zh: 从密集堆叠的存储环境中取回目标物体，需要在间隙有限、无法将目标物体从杂物上方抬起时，预判接触会如何扰动周围物体。然而，接触扰动可能传播至目标物体的直接相邻物体之外，同时累积的预测误差会使学习到的动力学模型在长时域规划中变得不可靠。我们提出DARE（扰动感知取回，Disturbance-Aware REtrieval），一种几何感知的关系动力学框架，利用回溯校正来改进扰动感知取回的长时域预测。DARE编码紧凑的物体描述符，并通过物体级消息传递预测以动作为条件的扰动传播。当获得稀疏观测时，学习到的校正器利用预测偏差修正先前预测的状态，并重新运行中间动力学过程，将校正沿预测的接触链传播。这些预测指导一个滚动时域规划器，在取回进度与周围物体的位移和旋转之间取得平衡，允许必要的接触同时抑制有害扰动。在平面环境和RoboCasa环境中的实验评估了密集杂物中扰动感知取回的长时域预测、泛化能力和鲁棒性。请访问我们的项目网站：https://the-back-to-the-future.github.io
tldr: DARE introduces a geometry-aware relational dynamics framework with retrospective correction for long-horizon disturbance prediction, guiding a receding-horizon planner for object retrieval in dense clutter.
tldr_zh: DARE提出了一种结合几何感知关系动力学与回溯校正的框架，用于密集杂乱环境下的长期扰动预测，并指导滚动时域规划器进行物体取回。

title: Control Barrier Functions for Safety-Aware Latent-Space Motion Planning
summary: Latent-space path planning (LSPP) compresses the configuration space of a robotic manipulator into a compact, differentiable manifold learned by a variational autoencoder, enabling fast gradient-based planning without explicit inverse kinematics. Existing LSPP frameworks enforce obstacle avoidance with a binary collision classifier, whose saturated gradients near obstacle boundaries and lack of temporal structure cause the optimizer to stall and provide no forward-invariance guarantee. We replace the classifier with a neural control barrier function (CBF) learned directly in the latent space. The barrier is trained with a three-term objective that combines safe and unsafe sign constraints with a discrete-time decrease condition evaluated on transitions of an obstacle-blind nominal planner, and it is enforced at planning time by a closed-form, first-order correction that projects each goal-directed latent step back onto the CBF constraint. On a 7-DoF Franka Panda manipulator, the CBF planner achieves a 75.6\% success rate on a fixed-obstacle task, 12.0 percentage points above the best of 35 tuned classifier configurations, and 83.8\% on a multi-position task. A sweep of the decay rate $α$ characterizes the safety--performance trade-off, with the best operating points in $α\in [0.10, 0.20]$. In a fully general random-obstacle setting, success drops to 33.0\%, which we trace to covariate shift between the obstacle-blind training transitions and the states visited by the corrected planner.
summary_zh: 潜在空间路径规划（LSPP）将机械臂的构型空间压缩为由变分自编码器学习得到的紧凑可微流形，从而无需显式逆运动学即可实现快速的基于梯度的规划。现有LSPP框架采用二值碰撞分类器来强制执行避障，但该分类器在障碍边界附近梯度饱和且缺乏时间结构，导致优化器停滞，并且无法提供前向不变性保证。我们用直接在潜在空间中学习的神经控制屏障函数（CBF）替代该分类器。该屏障函数通过三项目标进行训练，将安全与不安全符号约束与在障碍盲名义规划器状态转移上评估的离散时间递减条件相结合，并在规划时通过闭式一阶校正来强制执行，该校正将每个面向目标的潜在步骤投影回CBF约束。在7自由度Franka Panda机械臂上，CBF规划器在固定障碍任务中达到75.6%的成功率，比35种调优分类器配置中的最佳结果高出12.0个百分点，在多位置任务中达到83.8%。对衰减率$α$的扫描刻画了安全性—性能权衡，最佳工作点位于$α\in [0.10, 0.20]$。在完全通用的随机障碍设置中，成功率降至33.0%，我们将其归因于障碍盲训练状态转移与校正后规划器所访问状态之间的协变量偏移。
tldr: This paper replaces binary collision classifiers with a learned neural control barrier function (CBF) in latent-space path planning for robotic manipulators, enabling safety-aware motion planning with closed-form gradient corrections and improved success rates on a 7-DoF Franka Panda.
tldr_zh: 本文在机器人操作器的潜在空间路径规划中，用学习得到的神经控制屏障函数（CBF）替代二元碰撞分类器，通过闭环梯度修正实现安全感知的运动规划，并在7自由度Franka Panda上提高了成功率。

title: CompliantBot: Learning Whole-Body Compliance across Task Interfaces for Humanoid Control
summary: Humanoid controllers need the ability to yield to external forces while retaining the capacity to resume their original tasks. However, tracking objectives penalize the deviations needed for yielding, while relaxing tracking goals persistently can make task recovery harder. Existing approaches often rely on task-specific interaction command interfaces or constructed compliant motion data and reference trajectories, limiting the direct reuse of their compliance-training mechanisms across different task interfaces. We introduce CompliantBot, a compliance-training framework for motion tracking and velocity-command locomotion. It preserves the original task inputs and requires no preconstructed compliant data or target trajectories. A state-dependent interaction force field couples applied loads to the robot's motion, enabling local articulation and whole-body movement to change the forces experienced. A complementary force-magnitude reward encourages lower interaction loads, while task rewards are downweighted during loading and restored after release to coordinate yielding and task resumption. The trained policies use task inputs and proprioceptive history without explicit external-force measurements. Across both task interfaces, CompliantBot yields farther under constant pulls and experiences lower spring interaction loads than matched baselines, while resuming task tracking after force removal. CompliantBot achieves the highest task completion among the compared methods under stronger pulls. Power evaluations further show that CompliantBot has the lowest mean joint mechanical power among the compared methods. Real-robot demonstrations further illustrate compliant responses through arm motion, stepping, and body reorientation.
summary_zh: 人形控制器需要具备应对外部力量的能力，同时保留恢复其原始任务的能力。然而，跟踪目标会惩罚屈服所需的偏差，而持续放松跟踪目标则可能使任务恢复变得更加困难。现有方法往往依赖于特定任务的交互命令接口，或构造柔顺运动数据和参考轨迹，限制了其柔顺训练机制在不同任务接口间的直接复用。我们提出了CompliantBot，一种用于运动跟踪和速度指令行走的柔顺训练框架。它保留原始任务输入，无需预先构造的柔顺数据或目标轨迹。一个状态相关的交互力场将施加的负载与机器人运动耦合，使局部关节活动和全身运动能够改变所受到的力。一个互补的力幅奖励鼓励更低的交互负载，而任务奖励在加载期间被降低权重并在释放后恢复，以协调屈服与任务恢复。训练后的策略使用任务输入和本体感受历史，无需显式的外部力测量。在两种任务接口下，CompliantBot在持续拉力下屈服距离更远，且弹簧交互负载低于匹配的基线方法，同时在撤去外力后能够恢复任务跟踪。在更强拉力下，CompliantBot在比较方法中实现了最高的任务完成率。功率评估进一步表明，CompliantBot在比较方法中具有最低的平均关节机械功率。真实机器人演示进一步展示了通过手臂运动、迈步和身体重定向实现的柔顺响应。
tldr: CompliantBot is a compliance-training framework for humanoid control that enables robots to yield to external forces while resuming tasks, using a state-dependent interaction force field and force-magnitude rewards without needing compliant data or external force measurements.
tldr_zh: CompliantBot 是一种用于人形机器人控制的合规训练框架，使机器人能够在屈服于外力后恢复任务，利用状态相关的交互力场和力幅度奖励，无需合规数据或外部力测量。

title: Route-Guided CBF-QP Repair for Safe Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models can generate task-oriented robot actions, but they do not guarantee safe execution in obstacle-rich manipulation scenes. Although CBF-QP safety filters can locally project unsafe actions into a safe set, such correction may push the robot away from the learned task trajectory and leave the VLA policy without a reliable recovery direction. We propose Route-Guided CBF-QP Repair, a post-hoc repair module that uses the short-horizon action chunk predicted by the VLA to detect blocked nominal trajectories and generate entry-exit-rejoin guidance around obstacles. The selected route is added to the CBF-QP objective as a soft guidance term, while the CBF safety constraint remains hard. On SafeLIBERO, our method improves collision avoidance, task success, and SafeSuccess compared with AEGIS. Our project page is available at GitHub.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够生成面向任务的机器人动作，但无法保证在障碍物密集的操作场景中安全执行。尽管CBF-QP安全滤波器可以将不安全动作局部投影到安全集内，但这种修正可能使机器人偏离已学习的任务轨迹，导致VLA策略缺乏可靠的恢复方向。我们提出Route-Guided CBF-QP Repair，一种事后修复模块，利用VLA预测的短时域动作块来检测被阻塞的标称轨迹，并生成绕过障碍物的进入-退出-回归引导。所选路径作为软引导项添加到CBF-QP目标函数中，而CBF安全约束始终保持硬约束。在SafeLIBERO上，与AEGIS相比，我们的方法在碰撞避免、任务成功率和SafeSuccess方面均有提升。我们的项目页面见GitHub。
tldr: This paper introduces a post-hoc safety module that uses short-horizon action chunks from a VLA model to generate route guidance for a CBF-QP safety filter, improving collision avoidance and task success in manipulation scenes.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种后置安全模块，利用VLA模型的短时动作块生成路线引导，增强CBF-QP安全过滤器，在操作场景中提升避障和任务成功率。

title: GatedVLA with Camera-Based Emergency Braking: AlpaSim E2E Closed Loop Challenge Technical Report
summary: This report presents GatedVLA, our entry for the Physical AI AV (PAI-AV) track. Our learned vision-language-action (VLA) policy pairs the driving-pretrained Qwen-Drive-1.0-4B vision-language model with a layer-wise flow-matching action expert that outputs a 2.5 s horizon of acceleration and curvature controls, augmented with a soft visual mask applied to the expert's cross-attention. Compared to an identically trained baseline, the masked policy achieves comparable overall open-loop error while reducing error on left turns. In local closed-loop evaluation across the same 150 scenes (two rollouts per scene), the visual mask increases the mean scene score from 0.479 to 0.517 (paired difference +0.038, 95% bootstrap CI [-0.018, +0.093], wins/losses 37/26, sign test p = 0.21). Incorporating a rule-based automatic emergency braking (AEB) module at deployment further increases the mean score to 0.599 (+0.082, CI [+0.023, +0.143]) and reduces the mean number of scenes with at-fault collisions from 34.0 to 11.0.
summary_zh: 本报告介绍了我们为物理AI自动驾驶（PAI-AV）赛道提交的方案GatedVLA。我们学习的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略将经过驾驶预训练的Qwen-Drive-1.0-4B视觉语言模型与逐层流匹配动作专家相结合，输出2.5秒时域的加速度和曲率控制，并对专家的交叉注意力施加了软视觉掩码。与同等训练的基线模型相比，采用掩码的策略在整体开环误差上相当，同时降低了左转场景中的误差。在相同150个场景（每个场景两次 rollout）的本地闭环评估中，视觉掩码将平均场景得分从0.479提升至0.517（配对差异+0.038，95%自助法置信区间[-0.018, +0.093]，胜/负场次37/26，符号检验p=0.21）。在部署时引入基于规则的自动紧急制动（AEB）模块后，平均得分进一步提升至0.599（+0.082，置信区间[+0.023, +0.143]），平均负有责任碰撞场景数从34.0降至11.0。
tldr: GatedVLA pairs a driving-pretrained Qwen-Drive VLM with a layer-wise flow-matching action expert for closed-loop E2E driving, adding a soft visual mask on cross-attention and a rule-based AEB module that improves scene scores and reduces at-fault collisions.
tldr_zh: GatedVLA 将驾驶预训练的 Qwen-Drive-1.0-4B 视觉语言模型与逐层流匹配动作专家结合，输出加速度与曲率控制，并引入软视觉掩码与规则式自动紧急制动（AEB），在闭环评测中提升了场景得分并减少有责碰撞。

title: UA-Depth: Uncertainty-Aware Depth Restoration for Material-Agnostic Object Manipulation
summary: Robotic manipulation requires accurate metric depth, yet commodity RGB-D cameras often fail on non-Lambertian objects such as transparent, reflective, and translucent materials, producing holes, structured noise, and biased depth. Most restoration methods produce only a single depth map, treating noisy and reliable regions uniformly for downstream tasks while ignoring regional uncertainty. We present UA-Depth, an uncertainty-aware depth restoration framework that iteratively co-refines depth and pixel-wise uncertainty, and uses uncertainty-gated features to suppress unreliable cues for stable updates. To strengthen zero-shot behavior, UA-Depth leverages a frozen depth foundation model as a prior to initialize missing or unreliable depth, and applies two-stage MAD-weighted log-depth scale normalization to reduce outlier bias in relative-to-metric alignment. We introduce an eight-dataset zero-shot benchmark across diverse scenes, materials, and sensors. Across these benchmarks, UA-Depth achieves the best mean rank among representative baselines, with particularly strong gains on datasets dominated by transparent and reflective objects. Beyond depth metrics, we demonstrate downstream improvements in category-level 6D pose estimation and 6D grasp synthesis by exploiting the predicted uncertainty. \emph{Code, models, and data for training and evaluation will be released upon publication.}
summary_zh: 机器人操作需要精确的度量深度，然而商用RGB-D相机在非朗伯物体（如透明、反光和半透明材质）上往往表现不佳，会产生空洞、结构化噪声和深度偏差。大多数修复方法仅生成单张深度图，在下游任务中对噪声区域和可靠区域一视同仁，而忽略了区域不确定性。我们提出UA-Depth，一种不确定性感知的深度修复框架，该框架迭代地联合优化深度和逐像素不确定性，并利用不确定性门控特征来抑制不可靠线索以实现稳定更新。为增强零样本性能，UA-Depth利用冻结的深度基础模型作为先验来初始化缺失或不可靠的深度，并应用两阶段MAD加权对数深度尺度归一化，以减少相对深度到度量深度对齐中的异常值偏差。我们引入了一个涵盖多种场景、材质和传感器的八数据集零样本基准。在这些基准上，UA-Depth在代表性基线方法中取得了最佳平均排名，在以透明和反光物体为主的数据集上提升尤为显著。除了深度指标之外，我们通过利用预测的不确定性，展示了在类别级6D位姿估计和6D抓取合成方面的下游改进。\emph{用于训练和评估的代码、模型和数据将在论文发表后发布。}
tldr: This paper presents UA-Depth, an uncertainty-aware depth restoration framework for RGB-D cameras that iteratively co-refines depth and pixel-wise uncertainty, leveraging frozen depth foundation models and uncertainty-gated features to improve perception of non-Lambertian objects; it demonstrates downstream improvements in robotic manipulation tasks like 6D pose estimation and grasp synthesis.
tldr_zh: 本文提出UA-Depth，一种不确定性感知的深度恢复框架，通过迭代联合优化深度和像素级不确定性，并利用冻结的深度基础模型和不确定性门控特征，提升RGB-D相机对非朗伯体物体的感知，并在6D位姿估计和抓取合成等机器人操作任务中验证了改进效果。

title: SCOUT: Planning under Occlusion via Object-Centric World Model Rollouts
summary: Robots manipulating in cluttered spaces must often plan from partial views where foreground objects occlude the target, surrounding geometry, and usable free space. Reactive policies often miss these hidden constraints, while exhaustive search becomes computationally prohibitive in dense clutter. We present SCOUT, an occlusion-aware planning framework that bridges high-level deliberation with grounded physical rollouts. SCOUT leverages an object-centric scene representation to reconstruct hidden geometry and derive a relational planning state capturing blocker hierarchies and accessibility corridors. To navigate the vast action space in clutter, an LLM proposes structured action candidates which are then rigorously evaluated via Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) using a learned action-conditioned world model. Evaluations on 'Reveal' and 'Placement' tasks show that SCOUT outperforms Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies, embodied agents, and 3D world models, with significant gains in long-horizon tasks requiring reasoning over occluded geometry. We further validate the framework's robustness through real-world robotic manipulation in a cluttered shelf environment.
summary_zh: 在杂乱环境中操作的机器人通常需要从局部视角进行规划，此时前景物体会遮挡目标物体、周围几何结构以及可用的自由空间。反应式策略往往忽略这些隐藏约束，而在密集杂乱场景中，穷举搜索的计算开销则变得难以承受。我们提出了SCOUT，一种遮挡感知的规划框架，将高层级决策与基于物理的实体推演相连接。SCOUT利用以物体为中心的场景表示来重建隐藏几何结构，并推导出捕捉遮挡层级和可达走廊的关系型规划状态。为了在杂乱环境中应对庞大的动作空间，大语言模型提出结构化的动作候选，随后通过学习得到的动作条件世界模型，使用蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）对这些候选进行严格评估。在“揭示”和“放置”任务上的评估表明，SCOUT优于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略、具身智能体以及3D世界模型，在需要对遮挡几何进行推理的长时程任务中取得了显著提升。我们进一步通过在杂乱货架环境中进行的真实机器人操作实验，验证了该框架的鲁棒性。
tldr: SCOUT is an occlusion-aware planning framework that uses object-centric scene representation, LLM-proposed action candidates, and MCTS with a learned world model to plan under occlusion in cluttered robotic manipulation, outperforming VLA policies and world models on simulated and real tasks.
tldr_zh: SCOUT 是一个遮挡感知的规划框架，利用对象中心场景重建、LLM 提出的动作候选和基于学习的世界模型的蒙特卡洛树搜索，在杂乱的机器人操作场景中实现遮挡下的规划，并在仿真和真实任务中优于 VLA 策略和世界模型。

title: Recursive Self-Improvement of Exoskeleton Assistance Policies through Human-in-the-Loop Feedback
summary: To reduce reliance on manual design and extensive parameter tuning, a framework for the autonomous evolution of exoskeleton assistance policies through human feedback is proposed. Assistance policies are autonomously generated as executable control code by an intelligent agent and evaluated in experiments with human participants. Subjective user feedback, movement performance, and muscle activation measurements are incorporated into policy assessment. Based on these assessments, policy deficiencies are autonomously identified and the control code is revised by the agent for subsequent trials. A closed loop of policy generation, human feedback, evaluation, and autonomous refinement is thereby established. The framework is evaluated using GPT, DeepSeek, GLM, and Kimi, and initial assistance performance and refinement outcomes are compared across models. Despite differences in initial performance, effective assistance is achieved with all four models after a single autonomous refinement iteration under the tested conditions. Across three tasks, biceps and triceps muscle activation levels are reduced by 29.4% and 35.2%, respectively, compared with those measured without an exoskeleton. However, limited adaptability to unexpected situations is observed, indicating that further improvements in robustness and safety are required.
summary_zh: 为减少对手动设计和大量参数调优的依赖，提出了一种通过人类反馈实现外骨骼辅助策略自主进化的框架。辅助策略由智能体自主生成可执行控制代码，并在人体参与者实验中进行评估。主观用户反馈、运动表现和肌肉激活测量被纳入策略评估。基于这些评估，策略缺陷被自主识别，控制代码由智能体修订以用于后续试验。由此建立了策略生成、人类反馈、评估和自主优化的闭环。该框架使用GPT、DeepSeek、GLM和Kimi进行评估，并比较了各模型的初始辅助性能和优化结果。尽管初始性能存在差异，但在测试条件下，四种模型经过一次自主优化迭代后均实现了有效辅助。在三项任务中，与无外骨骼时测量的结果相比，肱二头肌和肱三头肌的肌肉激活水平分别降低了29.4%和35.2%。然而，观察到对突发情况的适应能力有限，表明鲁棒性和安全性仍需进一步改进。
tldr: This paper introduces a framework for autonomous evolution of exoskeleton assistance policies via human feedback, where an agent generates and refines control code using LLMs, reducing muscle activation across three tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种通过人类反馈自主进化外骨骼辅助策略的框架，智能体利用LLM生成并改进控制代码，在三个任务中降低肌肉激活。

title: Beyond Validation Loss: Coverage and Reliability Dynamics in Robot Policy Pretraining
summary: In modern robot learning, generative robot policies are first pretrained through supervised learning from demonstrations, then refined through reinforcement learning, supervised finetuning, or other forms of posttraining. Yet conventional pretraining metrics, such as validation loss and average task success, provide an incomplete account of which policies support both effective direct deployment and subsequent posttraining. In this work, we study closed-loop pass@k, which evaluates the probability that k rollouts from the same initial condition attain at least one success. Thus, pass@1 measures mean task success; large-k pass@k measures whether success remains reachable under repeated sampling. Across a wide range of posttraining recipes, we show that large-k pass@k reveals posttraining differences not captured by pass@1. In particular, checkpoints with similar pass@1 but different large-k pass@k have different posttraining performance. Moreover, we show pass@k peaks at different checkpoints during supervised pretraining, revealing a coverage-reliability tradeoff over the course of training. Based on these observations, we propose two practical interventions: (1) a purely offline checkpoint-selection criterion that balances coverage and reliability without closed-loop evaluation, and (2) a generative data augmentation procedure that expands supervision beyond the finite demonstration set, preserving large-k pass@k while maintaining or improving pass@1 and raising the observed coverage-reliability Pareto frontier. Together, our results motivate evaluation, checkpoint selection, and training procedures that explicitly account for posttraining. Blog post, visualizations, and code are available at https://zhanyisun.github.io/robot-policy-learning-dynamics/.
summary_zh: 在现代机器人学习中，生成式机器人策略首先通过监督学习从示范数据中进行预训练，随后通过强化学习、监督微调或其他形式的后期训练进行优化。然而，传统的预训练评估指标，如验证损失和平均任务成功率，无法全面反映哪些策略既能支持有效的直接部署，又能支持后续的后期训练。在本研究中，我们研究了闭环pass@k指标，该指标评估从相同初始条件出发的k次 rollout 中至少有一次成功的概率。因此，pass@1衡量平均任务成功率；而大k值的pass@k则衡量在重复采样下成功是否仍然可达。在广泛的后期训练方案中，我们表明大k值的pass@k能够揭示pass@1无法捕捉的后期训练差异。具体而言，具有相似pass@1但不同大k值pass@k的检查点，其后期训练表现存在差异。此外，我们发现在监督预训练过程中，pass@k在不同检查点达到峰值，揭示了训练过程中的覆盖度-可靠性权衡。基于这些观察，我们提出了两项实用干预措施：（1）一种纯离线的检查点选择标准，在不进行闭环评估的情况下平衡覆盖度和可靠性；（2）一种生成式数据增强方法，将监督扩展到有限示范集之外，在保持或提升pass@1的同时维持大k值的pass@k，并提高观察到的覆盖度-可靠性帕累托前沿。综上所述，我们的研究结果促使评估、检查点选择和训练流程明确考虑后期训练因素。博客文章、可视化和代码可在 https://zhanyisun.github.io/robot-policy-learning-dynamics/ 获取。
tldr: This paper studies closed-loop pass@k as a metric for robot policy pretraining, revealing a coverage-reliability tradeoff and proposing offline checkpoint selection and generative data augmentation to improve posttraining performance.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了闭环pass@k作为机器人策略预训练的评估指标，揭示了覆盖度-可靠性权衡，并提出了离线检查点选择和生成式数据增强方法以提升后续训练性能。

title: Democratizing Robot-Use Agents: A Unified Harness with Open Models
summary: Robot-use Agents (RUAs) have shown promising zero-shot manipulation capabilities, but reliance on frontier, proprietary models limits research into further training. To democratize RUA research, we introduce uni-robot-agent, a unified harness for competitive open-weight robot use that supports further training. Without privileged inputs, an out-of-the-box Qwen3.8-Flash-Next achieves a RoboDojo Score of 31.39, surpassing the published GPT-6 Astra-RoboProbe result of 28.97 and many VLA/WAM baselines, and performs competitively on 19 real-world tasks. Our analysis across model generations, families, and sizes links effective robot use to four general capabilities, suggesting that future RUA training should develop them jointly.
summary_zh: 机器人使用智能体（RUAs）已展现出有前景的零样本操作能力，但对前沿专有模型的依赖限制了进一步训练的研究。为推动RUA研究的普及化，我们推出了uni-robot-agent，一个统一的竞争性开放权重机器人使用框架，支持进一步训练。在没有特权输入的情况下，开箱即用的Qwen3.8-Flash-Next取得了31.39的RoboDojo分数，超越了已发表的GPT-6 Astra-RoboProbe结果28.97以及许多VLA/WAM基线，并在19项真实世界任务中表现具有竞争力。我们对不同模型代际、家族和规模的分析将有效的机器人使用与四项通用能力联系起来，表明未来的RUA训练应联合发展这些能力。
tldr: This paper introduces uni-robot-agent, a unified harness enabling competitive open-weight robot-use agents (RUAs) without proprietary models, achieving state-of-the-art RoboDojo scores and analyzing the general capabilities required for effective robot use.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了uni-robot-agent，一个统一的框架，使开源权重机器人使用代理（RUA）无需专有模型即可达到竞争力性能，在RoboDojo基准上取得领先分数，并分析了有效机器人使用所需的一般能力。

title: $TF^2$-Steering: Action Refinement with Tactile Forecasts and Feedback via Velocity-Field Steering
summary: Tactile sensing plays a crucial role in everyday human interaction. Consider inserting a plug into a tight socket, vision alone provides limited guidance during the final insertion stage, and we instead rely on both anticipated contact and realized tactile feedback to ajust the insertion motion. The same capability is equally important for robots, particularly in dexterous manipulation tasks. Yet many contemporary robot policies remain vision-dominant. This visual bias, compounded by limited tactile data and sparse contact events, can cause directly incorporated tactile signals to be ignored or even compromise the policy's pretrained capabilities, yielding degrading performance as observed in our experiments. We present $TF^2$-Steering, which refines actions via learned residual steering of the flow-matching action expert's velocity field, using a tactile mixture-of-experts architecture to integrate both tactile forecasts and real-time tactile feedback. Together with specific designed three stages training recipe, $TF^2$-Steering enables tactile signals to correct and, when necessary, redirect the flow-matching action-generation process, while building on the strong action-generation capacity of the vision-based foundation policy. Extensive experiments across six simulated and six real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of $TF^2$-Steering. It outperforms the strongest evaluated baselines by 10.7 percentage points in average simulation success rate and 9.1 percentage points in average real-world progress success rate. Project page: https://yiming-cc.github.io/tf2-steering/.
summary_zh: 触觉感知在人类日常交互中扮演着至关重要的角色。以将插头插入紧密插座为例，在最终插入阶段，仅凭视觉提供的引导十分有限，我们转而依赖预期的接触和实际的触觉反馈来调整插入动作。同样的能力对于机器人而言同样不可或缺，尤其是在灵巧操作任务中。然而，当代许多机器人策略仍以视觉为主导。这种视觉偏向，加之有限的触觉数据和稀疏的接触事件，可能导致直接融入的触觉信号被忽略，甚至削弱策略的预训练能力，从而在实验中观察到性能退化。我们提出$TF^2$-Steering，该方法通过学习得到的残差转向机制，对基于流匹配的动作专家速度场进行精细调整，并采用触觉混合专家架构来整合触觉预测与实时触觉反馈。结合专门设计的三阶段训练方案，$TF^2$-Steering使触觉信号能够修正甚至必要时重新引导流匹配动作生成过程，同时基于视觉基础策略的强大动作生成能力。在六个仿真和六个真实世界操作任务上的广泛实验证明了$TF^2$-Steering的有效性。其平均仿真成功率超越最强基线10.7个百分点，平均真实世界进度成功率超越最强基线9.1个百分点。项目页面：https://yiming-cc.github.io/tf2-steering/。
tldr: This paper introduces TF2-Steering, a method for dexterous manipulation that refines a vision-based flow-matching action expert's velocity field using tactile forecasts and feedback via a tactile mixture-of-experts architecture, enhancing task success in simulated and real-world scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了TF2-Steering，一种用于灵巧操作的方法，通过触觉混合专家架构，利用触觉预测和实时反馈来细化基于视觉的流匹配动作专家的速度场，从而提升模拟和真实世界任务的成功率。

title: Serving Agentic Robot Fleets: Workload Characterization, KV-Cache Thrashing, and Admission Control
summary: Agentic robots combine a vision-language brain, a tool-using harness, and a vision-language-action (VLA) policy. Serving a fleet of these agents introduces two coupled resource constraints: the brain repeatedly revisits long, growing key-value (KV) cache states, while the VLA executes action chunks under tight control deadlines. We characterize 80 LIBERO-PRO episodes generated by GPT-6-Astra, RPent, and pi0.5 (1,862 brain turns and 1,582 VLA inference chunks), profile both layers on H800 graphics processing units (GPUs), and replay the resulting agent programs on a vLLM serving engine. Brain contexts reach 215k tokens; the median Astra request takes 7.78 s, while the intervening environment-step gap is only 1.0 s. Under a 0.25 s action-chunk deadline, one VLA GPU meets the 1% starvation target for one robot; under a 1.0 s deadline, its measured capacity reaches at least 32. In sustained brain replay, increasing concurrency from 20 to 32 robots reduces throughput from about 2.4 to 0.6 requests/s as repetitive prefill displaces generation. A static active-episode cap restores 2.24-2.25 requests/s and raises completed trace-program throughput from 1.30 to 5.00-5.55 episodes/min. Our measurements expose the workload-dependent shift between action deadlines and brain KV residency, and establish practical principles for capacity planning and admission in sustained agentic robot fleets.
summary_zh: 智能体机器人结合了视觉-语言大脑、工具使用接口以及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略。运行这样一组智能体面临两个相互耦合的资源约束：大脑反复访问不断增长的长键值（KV）缓存状态，而VLA则在严格的控制截止时间内执行动作片段。我们对由GPT-6-Astra、RPent和pi0.5生成的80个LIBERO-PRO任务片段（包括1，862次大脑调用和1，582次VLA推理片段）进行了特征分析，在H800图形处理器（GPU）上对两个层次进行了性能剖析，并在vLLM服务引擎上重放了生成的智能体程序。大脑上下文长度最高达215k个token；Astra请求的中位耗时为7.78秒，而其间环境步骤间隔仅为1.0秒。在0.25秒的动作片段截止时间下，一个VLA GPU可满足单台机器人1%的饥饿率目标；在1.0秒的截止时间下，其测量容量至少达到32台机器人。在持续的大脑重放中，并发数从20增加到32台机器人时，吞吐量从约2.4请求/秒降至0.6请求/秒，原因在于重复的预填充取代了生成过程。采用静态活动片段上限后，吞吐量恢复至2.24-2.25请求/秒，并将完整迹程序吞吐量从1.30提升至5.00-5.55个任务片段/分钟。我们的测量揭示了动作截止时间与大脑KV驻留之间随工作负载变化的权衡关系，并为持续运行的智能体机器人队列的容量规划与准入控制确立了实用原则。
tldr: This paper characterizes the serving workloads of agentic robot fleets, profiling both the vision-language brain and VLA policy under real-time constraints, and proposes admission control to mitigate KV-cache thrashing and improve throughput.
tldr_zh: 本文对智能体机器人集群的服务工作负载进行了表征，分析了视觉-语言大脑和 VLA 策略在实时约束下的性能，并提出准入控制以缓解 KV 缓存抖动并提高吞吐量。

title: Same Path, Less Time: Training-Free Fast Execution of Vision-Language-Action Models under Inference Latency
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models predict chunks of future actions, yet deployed robots waste time in two ways that are independent of model capability: they halt while the next chunk is inferred, and they move at the speed of slow, cautious demonstrations. Existing remedies remove one loss each, and stacking them fails, because asynchrony and speed-up each change the correspondence between planned progress and executed motion. We present Path-preserving Time Scaling (PTS), a training-free execution layer for frozen action-chunking policies built on one principle: the robot's motion is a time reparameterization of a reference path, and the path changes only in response to new observations. A path layer decodes every replan deterministically in one step and enters it at the progress consumed during inference. A time layer sums the planned increments, keeps the arm at 1x while the gripper moves, and caps the rate by the actuator's linear range and by chunk feasibility under latency. We show that misaligned entry and stochastic sampling add a bias and a variance to the continuation error, and derive a break-even success rate that states when speeding up pays off. On LIBERO with two frozen VLAs under injected inference latency, PTS raises task throughput over the strongest deployable baseline by 33% for pi0.5 and 104% for SmolVLA while matching or improving the success rate, is best on all six model-suite combinations, and exceeds zero-latency 1x execution. Against asynchronous 1x execution with the same one-step decoder, the time layer alone adds 28% and 38%. On LIBERO-Dynamic it improves on stop-and-wait execution by 38% and is comparable to asynchronous 1x execution.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型预测未来动作的片段，然而已部署的机器人会在两个方面浪费时间，且这两个方面与模型能力无关：在推断下一片段时机器人会停顿，以及其移动速度受限于缓慢且谨慎的示范数据。现有的补救措施各自仅消除一种损失，而简单叠加这些措施会失败，因为异步化和加速都会分别改变计划进度与实际执行运动之间的对应关系。我们提出路径保持时间缩放（PTS），这是一种无需训练的执行层，适用于冻结的动作分块策略，其核心原则是：机器人的运动是参考路径的时间重参数化，且路径仅在收到新观测时才会改变。路径层以单步方式确定性解码每次重新规划，并从推断期间已消耗的进度处进入该路径。时间层对计划增量进行累加，在夹爪运动时保持手臂以1倍速运行，并根据执行器的线性范围和延迟下的分块可行性对速率进行上限约束。我们证明了未对齐的进入点和随机采样会分别给延续误差引入偏差和方差，并推导出一个盈亏平衡成功率，用以判定加速在何种条件下值得采用。在LIBERO基准上，将两种冻结VLA模型置于注入推断延迟的条件下，PTS相较于最强的可部署基线将pi0.5和SmolVLA的任务吞吐量分别提升了33%和104%，同时成功率持平或更高，在所有六种模型-套件组合中均表现最佳，并超过了零延迟1倍速执行的效果。与使用相同单步解码器的异步1倍速执行相比，仅时间层就分别带来了28%和38%的提升。在LIBERO-Dynamic上，PTS相较于停顿等待式执行提升了38%，且与异步1倍速执行相当。
tldr: PTS is a training-free execution layer for frozen action-chunking VLA policies that preserves the planned path while reparameterizing time to hide inference latency and accelerate cautious demonstrations. On LIBERO with injected latency it raises throughput by up to 104% over the strongest deployable baseline while matching or improving success, and exceeds zero-latency 1x execution.
tldr_zh: PTS 是一种无需训练的冻结动作分块 VLA 策略执行层，通过时间重参数化保持参考路径不变，从而隐藏推理延迟并加速保守演示。在注入延迟的 LIBERO 上，相比最强可部署基线吞吐量最高提升 104%，成功率持平或更高，甚至超过零延迟 1x 执行。

title: DriftingPlanner: Drifting Generative Models for One-Step Trajectory Planning in End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end planners decode the ego trajectory either by coordinate regression, which is fast but blends plausible maneuvers into one trajectory that may follow none of them, or by diffusion and flow matching, which model the trajectory distribution but need several inference steps. Drifting models move this iteration into training: a one-step generator learns to follow an attraction--repulsion field between generated and ground-truth samples. Drifting was developed for class-conditional image generation, where every class supplies many positive samples. In planning, every scene is its own condition. Pooling scenes would attract the generated trajectories of one scene to the ground truth of unrelated scenes, whereas computing the field per scene leaves a single positive, the expert trajectory. Mutual repulsion then holds the generated trajectories on a shell around it, so any single generated trajectory deviates from the ground truth. We present DriftingPlanner, a trajectory planner trained with the drifting loss alone, without any coordinate regression term. It computes the field per scene and removes the shell at inference: it decodes every noise vector together with its negation in one batched pass, and averaging each antithetic pair cancels the linear part of the displacement from the shell center. On NAVSIM navtest, DriftingPlanner reaches a state-of-the-art 93.75 PDMS, and with single-step inference its drifting decoder comes within 0.13 PDMS of the best diffusion or flow matching setting, which needs ten inference steps.
summary_zh: 端到端规划器通过坐标回归解码自车轨迹，该方法速度快，但会将多种合理 maneuvers 混合成一条可能不遵循其中任何一种的轨迹；或者通过扩散和流匹配方法，这些方法能够建模轨迹分布，但需要多次推理步骤。漂移模型将这一迭代过程转移到训练阶段：一个单步生成器学习遵循生成样本与真实样本之间的吸引-排斥场。漂移模型最初是为类条件图像生成而开发，其中每个类别提供大量正样本。在规划中，每个场景都有自身的条件。合并场景会将一个场景的生成轨迹吸引到无关场景的真实轨迹上，而按场景计算场则只留下一个正样本，即专家轨迹。此时，相互排斥会将生成轨迹保持在围绕该正样本的壳层上，因此任何单条生成轨迹都会偏离真实轨迹。我们提出了 DriftingPlanner，一种仅使用漂移损失训练的轨迹规划器，不含任何坐标回归项。它在每个场景中计算场，并在推理时移除壳层：它以批量方式一次性解码每个噪声向量及其相反向量，并对每个对偶样本取平均，以抵消相对于壳层中心的线性位移分量。在 NAVSIM navtest 上，DriftingPlanner 达到了最先进的 93.75 PDMS，且通过单步推理，其漂移解码器与最佳扩散或流匹配设置（需十步推理）的差距仅为 0.13 PDMS。
tldr: DriftingPlanner applies drifting generative models to one-step trajectory planning in end-to-end autonomous driving, using antithetic decoding to remove the inference-time shell and achieve state-of-the-art PDMS on NAVSIM navtest with single-step inference.
tldr_zh: DriftingPlanner 将漂移生成模型应用于端到端自动驾驶中的单步轨迹规划，利用对偶解码消除推理时的壳效应，在 NAVSIM navtest 上以单步推理达到最先进的 PDMS。

title: Learning Agile Humanoid Dodgeball with Onboard Monocular Vision
summary: Humanoid robots operating in shared, dynamic environments must respond to rapidly approaching objects while maintaining balance. We study dodgeball as a controlled test of this capability, coupling visual threat assessment with whole-body evasion, recovery, and target reacquisition. We develop a system that integrates onboard monocular perception, temporal ball-state and threat-flag estimation, and learned whole-body control. A ball detector supplies bounding-box histories, and a temporal estimator predicts relative ball position and a binary threat flag. Separate dodge/recovery and search/track policies share this interface and are composed to support repeated encounters. A three-stage curriculum first trains control with privileged ball states, then starts estimator supervision from stable policy rollouts, and finally replaces the actor's privileged inputs with estimator outputs. Analytic projection and perception randomization provide detector-like training observations without image rendering. Across approach-angle bins in controlled simulation, dodge success ranges from 97.8--100.0% for 5.0 m launches at 6 m/s to 33.2--40.8% for 2.5 m launches at 10 m/s, with 1000 throws per speed--distance condition. On a physical Unitree G1, controlled single-throw success exceeds 85% over more than 15 trials. A hardware sequence demonstrates full-azimuth target reacquisition followed by another dodge. These results demonstrate an integrated onboard-monocular-vision system under highly dynamic motions.
summary_zh: 在共享动态环境中运行的人形机器人必须在保持平衡的同时，对快速接近的物体做出响应。本研究以躲避球作为该能力的受控测试，将视觉威胁评估与全身躲避、恢复及目标重新获取相结合。我们开发了一个集成系统，融合了机载单目感知、时间球状态与威胁标志估计，以及学习型全身控制。球检测器提供边界框历史数据，时间估计器预测球的相对位置及二值威胁标志。躲避/恢复策略与搜索/跟踪策略共享此接口，并通过组合以支持多次遭遇。三阶段课程首先使用特权球状态训练控制，随后从稳定的策略滚动中启动估计器监督，最后用估计器输出替换行动者的特权输入。解析投影与感知随机化提供了类似检测器的训练观测，无需图像渲染。在受控仿真中，按接近角度区间划分，5.0米发射速度6米/秒的躲避成功率为97.8%—100.0%，2.5米发射速度10米/秒的躲避成功率为33.2%—40.8%，每个速度—距离条件下各进行1000次投掷。在实体Unitree G1上，受控单次投掷成功率在超过15次试验中高于85%。硬件序列演示了全方位目标重新获取及随后的再次躲避。这些结果证明了一个集成机载单目视觉系统在高度动态运动下的有效性。
tldr: This paper presents an integrated system enabling a humanoid robot to dodge thrown balls using onboard monocular vision, combining temporal ball-state estimation with learned whole-body control and a curriculum that transfers from privileged to real perception. The system achieves high success rates in simulation and on a physical Unitree G1 robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一套集成系统，使仿人机器人能够利用机载单目视觉躲避投掷的球，结合时间球状态估计和学习到的全身控制，并通过课程从特权状态转移到真实感知。该系统在仿真和物理Unitree G1机器人上均取得了较高的成功率。

title: ClothDojo: Learned Data Generation and Benchmarking for Bimanual Garment Flattening and Folding
summary: Garment flattening and folding require robots to identify garment structure during manipulation and adapt their actions as the cloth deforms. We present ClothDojo, a simulation platform that generates adaptive manipulation trajectories at scale across diverse garments and initial states and evaluates policies in closed loop. ClothDojo encodes each garment's canonical mesh coordinates as an NOCS texture, providing canonical surface-position cues through the visual interface of a pretrained vision-language-action model. We fine-tune the model on human demonstrations and corrections to obtain a data-generation policy. The policy autonomously generates simulated manipulation trajectories, and we retain rollouts that satisfy task-specific success criteria. Each retained trajectory is re-rendered under a randomly sampled appearance to provide RGB observations for downstream policies that do not receive NOCS. Across both tasks, the policy produces nearly 8,000 successful trajectories over hundreds of garments. RGB policies trained on these generated trajectories outperform those trained directly on the original human demonstrations and corrections across all evaluated garment splits and appearance settings. Evaluations across multiple policy models show that overall performance and appearance robustness vary across models and tasks, while generalization to unseen garments remains a common challenge.
summary_zh: 服装展平与折叠任务要求机器人在操作过程中识别服装结构，并随着布料变形自适应调整动作。我们提出了 ClothDojo——一个仿真平台，能够跨多种服装和初始状态大规模生成自适应操作轨迹，并在闭环中评估策略。ClothDojo 将每件服装的规范网格坐标编码为 NOCS 纹理，通过预训练视觉-语言-动作模型的视觉接口提供规范表面位置线索。我们在人类演示和纠正数据上微调该模型，以获得数据生成策略。该策略自主生成仿真操作轨迹，我们保留满足任务特定成功标准的 rollout。每条保留的轨迹在随机采样的外观下重新渲染，为不接收 NOCS 的下游策略提供 RGB 观测。在两个任务中，该策略在数百件服装上生成了近 8,000 条成功轨迹。在这些生成轨迹上训练的 RGB 策略在所有评估的服装划分和外观设置下，均优于直接在原始人类演示和纠正数据上训练的策略。对多种策略模型的评估表明，整体性能和外观鲁棒性因模型和任务而异，而对未见服装的泛化仍是共同挑战。
tldr: ClothDojo introduces a simulation platform that uses a fine-tuned vision-language-action model to generate large-scale adaptive garment manipulation trajectories, and shows that RGB policies trained on this generated data outperform those trained on human demonstrations for bimanual garment flattening and folding.
tldr_zh: ClothDojo 提出了一个仿真平台，利用微调后的视觉-语言-动作模型生成大规模的服装自适应操作轨迹，并表明基于这些生成数据训练的 RGB 策略在双手服装展开和折叠任务上优于基于人类演示训练的策略。

title: Do Embodied VLMs Actually Use Their Scene-Graph Memory?
summary: Embodied agents that answer questions about their route need a memory of what they saw, and scene graphs are a natural form for it. A vision-language model (VLM) can receive such a graph as text or through a graph encoder, but accuracy alone cannot show whether the graph holds the episode's facts, reaches the model, or is actually relied on. In this diagnostic study, we introduce a graph-swap test for the last of these: each episode is given another episode's graph, and we count how many answers change. On an embodied question-answering benchmark with routes through two to seven rooms, we use it to compare ways of delivering scene-graph memory to a fine-tuned VLM. As text, the memory is used strongly, adding 30 points on route questions. As a graph, it is not, and we trace why: the encoder preserves the information, but standard pooled and late fusion discard it. Giving each node its own input token recovers part of it, a gain of 8.3 points on route questions that the swap test confirms comes from the graph. The test also exposes a shortcut that accuracy hides: when the same facts appear in the text, the model ignores its graph. The test thus offers a cheap check of whether a VLM uses its scene-graph memory, and our analysis points to how that memory should be delivered.
summary_zh: 摘要：能够回答其路线相关问题的具身智能体需要记住其所见内容，而场景图是一种自然的信息存储形式。视觉语言模型（VLM）可以通过文本形式或图编码器接收此类图，但仅凭准确率无法判断该图是否包含了事件的关键事实、是否有效传递至模型，或者是否真正被模型所依赖。在本诊断性研究中，我们针对最后一点引入了一种“图交换测试”：将每个事件替换为另一事件的图，并统计答案发生变化的数量。在一条穿越两至七个房间的具身问答基准测试中，我们利用该测试比较了将场景图记忆传递给微调VLM的不同方式。当记忆以文本形式呈现时，模型对其利用显著，路线问题的得分提升了30分。而当记忆以图的形式输入时，模型并未充分利用，我们追溯了原因：图编码器保留了信息，但标准的池化与晚期融合方式却将其丢弃。为每个节点分配独立的输入标记可部分恢复该信息，路线问题得分提升8.3分，且交换测试证实该提升确实源自图的利用。该测试还揭示了一个被准确率掩盖的捷径：当相同事实出现在文本中时，模型会忽略其图输入。因此，该测试提供了一种低成本的手段来检验VLM是否使用其场景图记忆，而我们的分析则指出了该记忆应如何传递。
tldr: This paper introduces a graph-swap test to diagnose whether embodied VLMs actually use scene-graph memory, showing that textual memory is used strongly while graph encoders often discard it, with specific architectural changes recovering usage.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种图交换测试，用于诊断具身VLM是否真正使用场景图记忆，结果表明文本记忆被强使用，而图编码器常常丢弃信息，特定架构修改可恢复其使用。

title: Answering Without Arriving: An Evidence Audit for Embodied Question Answering
summary: Embodied question answering asks an agent to navigate, observe, and then answer questions about what it saw, yet answer accuracy alone cannot tell whether any of this happened. A plausible answer can come from the question, the room label, or the answer choices, and a correct answer does not show that the supporting observation was ever made. We present a multi-room benchmark whose 200 test episodes and 800 questions are stratified by route extent, with an evaluation ladder that holds the questions fixed while varying only the evidence supplied to the answerer, from text-only probes through closed-loop agents to replay of the reference trajectory. Questions are generated from symbolic records of rooms, visible objects, and frames, so every answer can be traced to the observations that support it. A closed-loop vision-language agent reaches no target in 200 episodes yet answers 45.5% of questions, within 0.1 points of the same model given no images; replaying the reference trajectory raises the same model to 57.4%, so the evidence exists along the route but is not gathered. A family-level audit then shows that access to evidence is not the same as use of it. Four of eight families are largely answerable from text, one cites frames that cannot establish its own answer, and the oracle conditions reach 59.5% on Rooms-visited by counting the supplied images. Evidence acquisition, answer coverage, and shortcut sensitivity must therefore be established before an accuracy gain can be credited to memory.
summary_zh: 具身问答要求智能体导航、观察，然后回答关于其所见内容的问题，然而仅凭回答准确率无法判断这一切是否真正发生。一个看似合理的答案可能来自问题本身、房间标签或选项列表，而一个正确的答案并不表明支撑该答案的观察确实发生过。我们提出了一个多房间基准测试，其200个测试回合和800个问题按路径范围分层，并配有一套评估阶梯：保持问题固定不变，仅改变提供给回答者的证据，从纯文本探测到闭环智能体，再到参考轨迹的回放。问题由房间、可见物体和帧的符号记录生成，因此每个答案都可追溯到支撑它的观察。一个闭环视觉语言智能体在200个回合中未能到达任何目标，却回答了45.5%的问题，与同一模型在无图像条件下仅差0.1个百分点；回放参考轨迹将同一模型提升至57.4%，说明证据存在于路径沿途但未被收集。随后一项家族层面的审计表明，获取证据并不等同于使用证据。八个家族中有四个在很大程度上可仅凭文本作答，一个引用了无法支撑其自身答案的帧，而预言机条件在“访问房间数”上通过计数所供图像达到59.5%。因此，在将准确率提升归因于记忆之前，必须首先确立证据获取、答案覆盖和捷径敏感性。
tldr: This paper introduces a multi-room embodied question answering benchmark with an evidence audit, showing that vision-language agents can answer questions without gathering supporting evidence, and demonstrating that access to evidence does not guarantee its use.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个多房间具身问答基准，并通过证据审计表明，视觉语言代理可以在不收集支持性证据的情况下回答问题，且获得证据并不等于使用证据。

title: Dual Path Following for an Aerial Manipulator Under State and Input Constraints via Transverse Feedback Linearization
summary: This paper studies dual path following for a quadrotor carrying a three-degree-of-freedom arm. The center of mass of the combined system must follow a vehicle path and the end effector must follow a second path, while the arm respects its joint limits and avoids its singular postures. The vehicle and the arm are mechanically coupled, so one controller must handle both paths. With the center of mass and the end-effector path coordinates as outputs, and a dynamic extension of the thrust, the system admits a normal form without internal dynamics. We characterize the states where this normal form fails. We formulate the transverse feedback linearizing controller as a quadratic program that relaxes only the speed of the end effector along its path and imposes safety and actuator limits as inequality constraints. The program reduces to a scalar problem with a closed-form solution. If it remains strictly feasible for all time, the feedback is locally Lipschitz, both paths are invariant and attractive, and every constraint holds. In the physics engine Drake, the controller resolves a conflict between the two speed references by slowing the end effector while both paths remain invariant. By contrast, a cascade with a safety filter leaves both paths. Code and animations are available at https://gradslab.github.io/am_dual_pf-/
summary_zh: 本文研究了一架携带三自由度机械臂的四旋翼飞行器的双路径跟踪问题。组合系统的质心需跟踪一条飞行器路径，末端执行器需跟踪另一条路径，同时机械臂需满足关节限位并避免奇异姿态。飞行器与机械臂之间存在机械耦合，因此需由单一控制器同时处理两条路径。以质心和末端执行器的路径坐标作为输出，并对推力进行动态扩展后，该系统可化为无非零内部动态的标准型。我们刻画了该标准型失效的状态条件。我们将横向反馈线性化控制器表述为一个二次规划问题，该问题仅放松末端执行器沿其路径的速度约束，并将安全约束和执行器限幅作为不等式约束加入。该规划可化为具有闭式解的单变量问题。若该问题在所有时刻均严格可行，则反馈控制为局部Lipschitz连续的，两条路径均具有不变性与吸引性，且所有约束均满足。在物理引擎Drake中，该控制器通过降低末端执行器速度来解决两个速度参考之间的冲突，同时保持两条路径的不变性。相比之下，带安全滤波器的级联控制则会导致两条路径均偏离。代码与动画演示详见 https://gradslab.github.io/am_dual_pf-/
tldr: This paper presents a transverse feedback linearization controller for a quadrotor with a 3-DOF arm to simultaneously follow a vehicle path and an end-effector path under state and input constraints, formulated as a scalar quadratic program with closed-form solution.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种横向反馈线性化控制器，用于四旋翼携带三自由度机械臂同时跟踪载体路径和末端执行器路径，并满足状态和输入约束，该控制器被表述为具有闭式解的标量二次规划问题。

title: Shades of Success: Evaluating Manipulation Quality from Object-Centric Constraints
summary: As learned manipulation policies become increasingly capable of solving practical manipulation tasks, assessing how well a task is performed becomes a fundamental challenge. While binary labels confirm task success, they cannot distinguish successful executions with different levels of geometric precision. To address this, we introduce SPECTRA, an object-centric framework for quantifying execution quality in manipulation of rigid objects. From a small set of oracle demonstrations generated in simulation, SPECTRA represents object interactions through progress-aligned relative poses. SPECTRA identifies which relative-pose directions are constrained and their admissible variations from demonstrations. These constraints establish a reference for evaluating robotic manipulation tasks. To score an unseen execution, deviations beyond the admissible variation are summarized by a Task Quality Index Q in [0,1]. Across seven simulated tasks, SPECTRA recovers constraints with 94% accuracy using 30 demonstrations per task. On rollouts from three learned policies, its scores achieve pooled Spearman correlations with human judgments of p=0.81 over all rollouts and p=0.61 among successful rollouts, exceeding all baselines in both subsets. Using the task reference learned in simulation, we use SPECTRA to select the highest-scoring demonstrations for training a diffusion policy on hardware. Exploratory results show higher success rate than training on randomly selected demonstrations.
summary_zh: 随着学习型操作策略日益能够解决实际的操作任务，评估任务执行的质量已成为一项基本挑战。虽然二元标签可以确认任务是否成功，但无法区分不同几何精度水平的成功执行。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SPECTRA，一个以物体为中心的框架，用于量化刚体操作中的执行质量。基于在仿真中生成的一小组专家演示，SPECTRA通过进度对齐的相对位姿来表示物体交互。SPECTRA从演示中识别出哪些相对位姿方向受到约束及其允许的变化范围。这些约束为评估机器人操作任务建立了参考标准。为了对未见的执行进行评分，超出允许变化范围的偏差通过任务质量指数Q在[0,1]范围内进行汇总。在七个仿真任务中，SPECTRA在每个任务使用30个演示的情况下，以94%的准确率恢复了约束条件。在三个学习策略的 rollout 上，其评分与人类判断的合并Spearman相关性在所有 rollout 上达到p=0.81，在成功 rollout 中达到p=0.61，在两个子集中均超过了所有基线方法。利用在仿真中学习到的任务参考，我们使用SPECTRA选择得分最高的演示来在硬件上训练扩散策略。探索性结果显示，其成功率高于使用随机选择的演示进行训练的结果。
tldr: SPECTRA introduces an object-centric framework that learns manipulation quality constraints from a small number of simulation demonstrations, and uses them to quantify execution quality, showing correlations with human judgments and improving hardware policy training through demonstration selection.
tldr_zh: SPECTRA 提出了一种以物体为中心的框架，从少量仿真演示中学习操作质量约束，并用其量化执行质量，与人类判断具有相关性，并通过演示选择提高了硬件策略训练的成功率。

title: Differentiable Iterative Learning Control for Black-Box Position-Commanded Manipulators
summary: High-accuracy repetitive tracking is challenging for position-commanded manipulators whose low-level controllers are inaccessible, while constrained model-based iterative learning control (ILC) can require substantial manual parameter tuning. We present Differentiable Iterative Learning Control (Diff-ILC), an online bilevel framework that adapts the parameters of a constrained ILC update between physical robot executions. A closed-loop differential model is identified once from paired smooth perturbations and subsequently kept fixed. At each trial, a constrained quadratic program computes a feasible command correction, while a real-anchored next-trial prediction defines a task-level objective. Hypergradients are obtained by implicitly differentiating the locally active KKT system, enabling multiple computational parameter updates without additional robot executions. Experiments on a 6-DoF DOBOT CR3 across unseen planar and three-dimensional trajectories show substantially faster physical-trial convergence than fixed-parameter model-based ILC. Across the four primary trajectories, after only two trial-to-trial updates, Diff-ILC achieves 78.8% and 76.4% lower mean joint-vector and Cartesian RMSE, respectively, than fixed-parameter model-based ILC.
summary_zh: 高精度重复跟踪对于底层控制器不可访问的位置指令型机械臂而言具有挑战性，而基于模型的迭代学习控制（ILC）在受约束条件下可能需要大量的人工参数整定。本文提出了一种可微迭代学习控制（Diff-ILC）方法，这是一种在线双层框架，可在物理机器人执行之间调整受约束ILC更新参数。通过成对平滑扰动，仅需一次辨识即可获得闭环微分模型，并在后续过程中保持固定。每次试验中，一个受约束的二次规划用于计算可行的指令修正量，而基于真实锚定的下一试验预测则定义了任务级目标。通过对局部活跃的KKT系统进行隐式微分获得超梯度，从而在不增加机器人执行次数的情况下实现多个计算参数的更新。在6自由度DOBOT CR3上，针对未见过的平面及三维轨迹的实验结果表明，与固定参数的基于模型ILC相比，Diff-ILC在物理试验收敛速度上显著更快。在四条主要轨迹上，仅经过两次试验间更新，Diff-ILC的平均关节向量均方根误差（RMSE）和笛卡尔空间RMSE分别比固定参数模型ILC降低了78.8%和76.4%。
tldr: Diff-ILC is an online bilevel framework that adapts constrained iterative learning control parameters between real robot executions for high-accuracy repetitive tracking of black-box position-commanded manipulators.
tldr_zh: Diff-ILC 是一种在线双层框架，可在真实机器人执行之间自适应调整受约束迭代学习控制的参数，实现黑盒位置指令机械臂的高精度重复跟踪。

title: Safety4DM: A Vision-Language Framework for Risk-Aware Dynamic Maps in Vehicle-Road-Cloud Collaborative Driving
summary: Dynamic map (DM) is a core information infrastructure for vehicle-road-cloud (VRC) cooperative autonomous driving. It fuses perception data from multiple sources to overcome the inherent line-of-sight and field-of-view limits of single-vehicle perception. However, DM still falls short on driving safety in two ways. First, DM data specifications already define road conditions semantically, but no pipeline yet turns real-world road observations into fine-grained risk entities in the DM. Second, existing DM systems lack a natural language interface for driving risks. To close these gaps, we propose Safety4DM, a safety-oriented language system for VRC dynamic maps. We first build RoadRisk, a real-world road image dataset that covers four types of road conditions and four risk levels. On this dataset, we fine-tune a vision-language model (VLM) for road safety risk perception. The model outputs structured risk representations that the DM can ingest directly. We then introduce a Safety-aware Step-wise Prompting (SafeStep) mechanism as the natural language query interface of the DM. SafeStep answers queries accurately and also generates actionable driving advice. To build and evaluate this interface, we develop SafeVRC-Sim, a VRC cooperative simulation framework, and SafeDM-QA, a safety question-answering benchmark. Experiments show that even the compact Qwen3-VL-4B reaches 89.83% accuracy on risk perception after fine-tuning. SafeStep also plugs easily into multiple LLM families. With medium and large models (20B and above) from five families, it achieves over 93% natural language query accuracy in every case, which shows strong generalization.
summary_zh: 动态地图（DM）是车路云（VRC）协同自动驾驶的核心信息基础设施。它融合多源感知数据，以克服单车感知固有的视线和视野限制。然而，DM在驾驶安全方面仍存在两方面不足。第一，DM数据规范已在语义层面定义了道路状况，但尚无流程能将真实世界道路观测转化为DM中的细粒度风险实体。第二，现有DM系统缺乏面向驾驶风险的自然语言接口。为弥补这些差距，我们提出Safety4DM，一种面向安全的车路云动态地图语言系统。我们首先构建了RoadRisk，一个涵盖四类道路状况和四个风险等级的真实世界道路图像数据集。在该数据集上，我们微调了一个视觉语言模型（VLM）用于道路安全风险感知。该模型输出DM可直接接收的结构化风险表示。随后，我们引入安全感知逐步提示（SafeStep）机制作为DM的自然语言查询接口。SafeStep能够准确回答查询，并生成可操作的驾驶建议。为构建和评估该接口，我们开发了SafeVRC-Sim，一个车路云协同仿真框架，以及SafeDM-QA，一个安全问答基准。实验表明，即使是紧凑型的Qwen3-VL-4B在微调后在风险感知上也达到了89.83%的准确率。SafeStep还可轻松接入多个LLM系列。在使用来自五个系列的中型和大型模型（20B及以上）时，它在每种情况下均实现了超过93%的自然语言查询准确率，展现出强大的泛化能力。
tldr: Safety4DM is a vision-language framework that turns real-world road observations into fine-grained risk entities for vehicle-road-cloud dynamic maps and provides a natural language risk query interface with actionable driving advice.
tldr_zh: Safety4DM 是一个面向车路云动态地图的视觉语言框架，将真实道路观测转化为细粒度风险实体，并提供自然语言风险查询接口与可执行驾驶建议。

title: When Does Latent Prediction Error Support Physical Surprise Claims in Video World Models?
summary: Prediction errors from video world models are often treated as physical surprise, but they can also reflect appearance, static content, motion, or ordinary prediction difficulty. We present an evaluation framework that separates what frozen representations contain, how they organize appearance and physical differences, and what changes a model's own prediction error. On IntPhys2, a benchmark of physically possible and impossible events, we compare representations from latent prediction, masked pixel reconstruction, and simple visual statistics. Appearance remains easy to decode, while V-JEPA2 exposes modest information about whether events are possible or impossible. Looking at the latent geometry, appearance changes become smaller compared with differences between videos, their directions line up more consistently across scenes, and their overlap with physical changes decreases in deeper layers. Across action-conditioned models, incorrect actions raise prediction error, while appearance changes also produce substantial responses. In Physion++ video clips, repeating a single frame can produce higher error than the original clip, while changing color throughout the clip can lower it. Using Kubric, a simulation and rendering framework, we find that impossible events can produce lower error than possible events. A fixed error threshold also incorrectly flags many possible events as impossible. A model can therefore represent physical information and respond to incorrect actions without its native prediction error reliably measuring physical surprise.
summary_zh: 视频世界模型的预测误差通常被视为物理意外，但它们也可能反映外观、静态内容、运动或普通的预测难度。我们提出了一种评估框架，用于区分冻结表示所包含的内容、它们如何组织外观与物理差异，以及模型自身预测误差的变化来源。在IntPhys2（一个物理可能事件与不可能事件的基准）上，我们比较了潜在预测、掩码像素重建和简单视觉统计的表征。外观仍然易于解码，而V-JEPA2则暴露了关于事件是否可能或不可能的有限信息。观察潜在几何结构，外观变化相对于视频间的差异变得更小，其方向在场景间更一致，并与更深层中的物理变化重叠减少。在动作条件模型中，错误的动作会提高预测误差，而外观变化也会产生显著响应。在Physion++视频片段中，重复单帧所产生的误差可能高于原始片段，而改变整个片段的颜色可能降低误差。利用Kubric（一种仿真与渲染框架），我们发现不可能事件产生的误差可能低于可能事件。固定误差阈值还会错误地将许多可能事件标记为不可能。因此，模型可以表示物理信息并对错误动作作出响应，而其固有的预测误差却不能可靠地衡量物理意外。
tldr: This paper proposes an evaluation framework to assess whether prediction errors from video world models can serve as physical surprise signals, finding that errors often reflect appearance or prediction difficulty rather than physical impossibility.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个评估框架，检验视频世界模型中的预测误差是否能作为物理意外信号，发现误差往往反映外观或预测难度而非物理不可能性。

title: Teleoperation System for Service Robots using Virtual Reality Headset and Pose Estimation
summary: This paper presents a teleoperation system for service robots that integrates human pose estimation with virtual reality (VR) to enable intuitive remote control. By using the Mediapipe framework for 2D pose detection and extending it with RGB-D data from the Intel RealSense D455 camera, a comprehensive 3D human pose estimation is achieved. This data is then mapped to the robot's kinematics, allowing the operator to control the robot's movements naturally. A VR interface was developed to provide an immersive perspective, enhancing the operator's situational awareness. Real-world experiments were conducted using the CHARMIE service robot to validate the system's effectiveness in tasks involving object manipulation. While the current system successfully demonstrates the potential of VR-based teleoperation, challenges remain in accurately capturing certain joint angles (e.g., wrist yaw) and ensuring precise mapping between human and robot movements. Future work includes the integration of inertial measurement units (IMUs) for improved rotational tracking and the implementation of more advanced control algorithms. Overall, this research contributes to the development of more intuitive and effective teleoperation systems for service robots, facilitating their deployment in complex and dynamic environments. This work further introduces a novel approach to teleoperation by combining RGB-D sensing with an innovative algorithm for real-time joint angle computation using Mediapipe, enhancing the precision of human-robot motion mapping and enabling immersive control through a VR interface. These contributions represent significant advancements in the field of human-robot interaction, particularly for service robot applications.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种面向服务机器人的远程操作系统，该系统将人体姿态估计与虚拟现实（VR）相结合，以实现直观的远程控制。通过使用Mediapipe框架进行2D姿态检测，并结合Intel RealSense D455相机的RGB-D数据进行扩展，实现了全面的3D人体姿态估计。随后，该数据被映射到机器人的运动学模型上，使操作者能够自然地控制机器人的运动。研究还开发了一个VR界面以提供沉浸式视角，增强操作者的态势感知能力。使用CHARMIE服务机器人进行了真实环境实验，以验证系统在涉及物体操作任务中的有效性。虽然当前系统成功展示了基于VR的远程操作的潜力，但在准确捕捉某些关节角度（如腕部偏航）以及确保人与机器人运动之间的精确映射方面仍存在挑战。未来工作包括集成惯性测量单元（IMU）以改善旋转跟踪，以及实现更先进的控制算法。总体而言，本研究有助于推动更直观、更有效的服务机器人远程操作系统的开发，促进其在复杂动态环境中的部署。本研究进一步提出了一种新颖的远程操作方法，通过将RGB-D传感与一种利用Mediapipe进行实时关节角度计算的创新算法相结合，提高了人-机器人运动映射的精度，并通过VR界面实现了沉浸式控制。这些贡献代表了人-机器人交互领域的重要进展，尤其是在服务机器人应用方面。
tldr: This paper presents a teleoperation system for service robots that combines VR headset and RGB-D-based 3D human pose estimation to enable intuitive remote control, validated on the CHARMIE service robot for object manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种服务机器人遥操作系统，结合VR头显和基于RGB-D的3D人体姿态估计，实现直观的远程控制，并在CHARMIE服务机器人上进行了物体操作任务验证。

title: Leveraging 2D Foundation Priors for Generalized Category Discovery under Test-Time Adaptation in 3D LiDAR Segmentation
summary: In autonomous driving, 3D LiDAR semantic segmentation is expected to adapt to evolving environments and recognize previously unseen categories, making generalized category discovery under test-time adaptation (GCD-TTA) an important problem. However, existing works treat GCD and TTA separately, while the limited semantic information in 3D point clouds makes GCD-TTA under domain shift more prone to feature collapse when combining GCD with TTA. To address this issue, we propose a two-stage framework for GCD-TTA in 3D LiDAR semantic segmentation. Specifically, in the first stage, we adaptively aggregate local 3D features according to geometric density variations and obtain reliable pseudo labels under a global class-wise prototype consistency constraint. In the second stage, we cast category discovery as an optimal transport assignment process for globally consistent grouping of novel categories. Meanwhile, semantic features from 2D vision foundation models are fused with 3D point cloud features to enrich 3D semantic information and promote a more separable feature space. Extensive experiments on Synth4D to SemanticKITTI, SynLiDAR to SemanticKITTI, and Synth4D to nuScenes demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework. Under a unified evaluation protocol, our method achieves the best overall mIoU on 9 out of 10 benchmark splits and improves the overall mIoU by up to 12.21 points over the strongest re-implemented baseline.
summary_zh: 在自动驾驶领域，3D LiDAR语义分割需要适应不断变化的环境并识别先前未见过的类别，这使得测试时自适应下的广义类别发现成为一个重要问题。然而，现有研究将广义类别发现与测试时自适应分开处理，而3D点云中有限的语义信息使得在领域偏移条件下将两者结合时更容易导致特征坍缩。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种用于3D LiDAR语义分割中广义类别发现与测试时自适应的两阶段框架。具体而言，在第一阶段，我们根据几何密度变化自适应地聚合局部3D特征，并在全局类别级原型一致性约束下获得可靠的伪标签。在第二阶段，我们将类别发现建模为最优传输分配过程，以实现对新类别的全局一致性分组。同时，将2D视觉基础模型的语义特征与3D点云特征相融合，以丰富3D语义信息并促进更具可分性的特征空间。在Synth4D到SemanticKITTI、SynLiDAR到SemanticKITTI以及Synth4D到nuScenes上的大量实验验证了我们框架的有效性。在统一评估协议下，我们的方法在10个基准划分中的9个上取得了最佳整体mIoU，并且相比最强的重实现基线，整体mIoU最高提升了12.21个百分点。
tldr: This paper presents a framework for 3D LiDAR semantic segmentation that combines generalized category discovery with test-time adaptation, using 2D vision foundation model features to enrich 3D point cloud semantics. It demonstrates effectiveness across multiple autonomous driving domain-shift benchmarks, achieving state-of-the-art results.
tldr_zh: 本论文针对自动驾驶中的3D LiDAR语义分割，提出了一种结合广义类别发现与测试时适应的框架，利用2D视觉基础模型的语义特征增强3D点云特征，在多个跨域基准上取得了最佳效果。

title: MagPillar: A Soft Magnetopillar Array Tactile Sensor for Robotic Surface Perception
summary: Robotic surface exploration benefits from tactile interfaces that accommodate contact and capture variations in surface characteristics. Herein, we report MagPillar, a tactile sensor inspired by spider tactile hairs that combines a magnetic pillar array with three-axis Hall sensing. A full-array mechanical and magnetic-field model characterizes how pillar deformation affects the superposed fields measured across the array, providing a physical basis for interpreting its contact responses. The compliant pillar architecture translates contact with surface textures and geometric features into distinct magnetic response patterns. Then, in robotic surface perception experiments, spectral features and logistic regression distinguish six material surfaces with an offline accuracy of 99.34% under within-session temporally blocked cross-validation. Continuous scans over periodic protrusions produce amplitude and peak-spacing variations consistent with changes in surface geometry. These findings connect compliant contact mechanics with distributed magnetic sensing, paving a new path for material recognition and qualitative surface-profile perception.
summary_zh: 机器人表面探索得益于能够适应接触并捕捉表面特征变化的触觉接口。本文报道了MagPillar——一种受蜘蛛触觉毛启发、将磁性柱阵列与三轴霍尔传感相结合的触觉传感器。一个全阵列的力学与磁场模型刻画了柱体形变如何影响阵列上测量的叠加场，为其接触响应的解读提供了物理基础。柔顺柱体架构将接触表面纹理与几何特征转化为明显的磁场响应模式。随后，在机器人表面感知实验中，利用频谱特征与逻辑回归，在会话内时间分块交叉验证下，区分六种材料表面的离线准确率达到99.34%。对周期性突起物的连续扫描产生的振幅与峰间距变化与表面几何变化一致。这些发现将柔顺接触力学与分布式磁传感联系起来，为材料识别与定性表面轮廓感知开辟了新途径。
tldr: This paper introduces MagPillar, a soft magnetic pillar array tactile sensor with Hall sensing, demonstrating high accuracy in material recognition and qualitative surface-profile perception for robotic surface exploration.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于磁柱阵列和霍尔传感的柔性触觉传感器MagPillar，在机器人表面感知实验中实现了高精度的材料识别和表面轮廓定性感知。

title: Adaptive Surface Cleaning under Uncertain Cleaning Response
summary: Surface cleaning requires robots to adapt both where they clean and how they interact with contamination whose response to cleaning may vary spatially and remain unobservable prior to interaction. We formulate adaptive surface cleaning as a partially observable Markov decision process and propose a belief-aware planning framework that uses observed cleaning outcomes to update a latent local cleaning-response model and adapt subsequent cleaning motions, forces, and passes. Preliminary grid-world simulations demonstrate the resulting closed-loop planner adapting its spatial decomposition and cleaning actions as the surface evolves.
summary_zh: 表面清洁要求机器人不仅要适应清洁的位置，还要适应其与污染物的交互方式，而污染物对清洁的响应可能随空间变化，并且在交互之前无法观测。我们将自适应表面清洁建模为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程，并提出一种基于置信度感知的规划框架，该框架利用观测到的清洁结果更新潜在的局部清洁响应模型，并调整后续的清洁动作、作用力及清洁遍数。初步的网格世界仿真表明，所提出的闭环规划器能够随着表面状态的变化，自适应地调整其空间分解策略与清洁动作。
tldr: The paper proposes a belief-aware POMDP planning framework for adaptive surface cleaning that updates a latent cleaning-response model from observed outcomes and adapts cleaning motions and forces, with preliminary grid-world simulations.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于信念的POMDP规划框架，用于自适应表面清洁，通过观察清洁结果更新潜在清洁响应模型，并调整清洁动作和力度，初步网格世界模拟验证了效果。

title: Local Solution Repair for Multi-Agent Pickup and Delivery
summary: Multi-robot systems in automated warehouses must efficiently attend to a constant stream of pickup-and-delivery tasks while avoiding collisions. Existing Multi-Agent Pickup-and-Delivery (MAPD) solutions generate plans that are globally feasible but often locally inefficient. In large-scale, long-horizon deployments, these inefficiencies, such as robots backtracking from target goal locations and idling in congested areas, accumulate over time and degrade performance. This paper contributes Local Solution Repair (LSR), a goal replanning approach that detects suboptimal behaviors at run-time and locally improves plans to reduce conflict between agents. We demonstrate the utility of our approach by repairing solutions generated by state-of-the-art MAPD baselines, M2M and LNS-PBS. Our results in long-horizon warehouse simulations over three environments show upwards of 5.9% improvement in task throughput over current state-of-the-art methods by reducing the number of suboptimal instances by ~36k or by 14.6% with minor additional computation time.
tldr: This paper presents Local Solution Repair (LSR), a goal replanning approach that detects and locally improves inefficient robot behaviors in multi-agent pickup and delivery systems, improving task throughput in warehouse simulations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出局部解修复（LSR），一种目标重规划方法，用于检测并局部改进多智能体取送货系统中低效的机器人行为，在仓库模拟中提升任务吞吐量。

title: TriPhysBench: Evaluating Physical Intelligence for Embodied Agents
summary: Embodied agents need physical intelligence to understand their surroundings through physical perception, physical knowledge retrieval, and physical reasoning. These capabilities must work together to interpret events and make quantitative judgments.
